parsed.text: This packet reports, for panels p0 and p1 at represented times given in the record, the supplied location distributions over 4×4 grids for red and blue roles at nodes n0–n3. Current-view distributions are shown separately from candidate conditional-command estimates (commands k0–k2). Peaks (locations with maximum probability) are listed per distribution in the propositions. Panels differ where candidate records specify alternate peak sets (not executed events). Uniform distributions appear at several nodes (all 16 cells tied). In panel p1 candidate k1, node n3 blue peaks are the four cells (row 0–1, col 2–3) while red peaks are the four cells (row 0–1, col 0–1); other candidate and current records have single-cell peaks or full-grid ties as enumerated above.
